data.one_liner: Save files to the device using native save dialogs in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides an interface to write files as bytes or strings directly to the device. Uses native components like ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT on Android, UIDocumentPickerViewController on iOS, NSSavePanel on macOS, and the showSaveFilePicker API or download attributes on the Web.
use_when: You need to prompt the user to save a file to a specific location using a native dialog.
You want to save Uint8List bytes or text strings from a Flutter app across Android, iOS, web, or macOS.
avoid_when: You need support for Windows or Linux platforms.
You want background file downloading or automatic saving without opening a native user prompt.
strengths: Uses native save dialogs on Android, iOS, macOS, and web.
Supports both byte arrays and string contents.
weaknesses: Does not support Windows and Linux platforms.
Web implementation can throw a SecurityError if not called immediately after user interaction.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific configurations like setting minimum SDK version on Android, adding document browser/sharing permissions in Info.plist on iOS (requires iOS 16+), and adding user-selected read-write entitlements on macOS.
